Internal class for a binary SBM fit on the observed dyads, without covariates: MAR sampling designs, 'block-node' and 'block-dyad' (with their sampling term in the update of the blocks) and 'degree'.

Source: R/R6Class-simpleSBM_fit.R
SimpleSBM_fit_noCov.Rd

It is not designed to be called directly by the user.

Super classes

sbm::SBM -> sbm::SimpleSBM -> SimpleSBM_fit -> SimpleSBM_fit_noCov

SimpleSBM_fit_noCov$update_blocks()

Usage

SimpleSBM_fit_noCov$update_blocks(log_lambda = 0, ...)

Arguments

log_lambda

term of the sampling design depending on the blocks ('block-node' and 'block-dyad'), added to the update of the blocks; 0 for the other designs

SimpleSBM_fit_noCov$vExpec_imputed()

variational expectation of the log-likelihood of the missing dyads, given their imputations (used by the ICL of 'degree', see missSBM_fit)

Usage

SimpleSBM_fit_noCov$vExpec_imputed(nu, Z = private$Z)

Arguments

nu

the imputations of the missing dyads (sparse matrix with the pattern of the missing dyads)

Z

an n x Q matrix of memberships (default: the current variational ones)

SimpleSBM_fit_noCov$vExpec_at()

variational expectation of the log-likelihood of the observed dyads and of the blocks at given memberships (used by the ICL, at the MAP memberships)

Usage
